ops.title: Fresh Sprite startup: private local SquashFS payload (supersedes public-URL design)
ops.body:
Decision (2026-10-02, root-directed, PR #24): fresh Sprites mount a PRIVATE, pinned SquashFS (zstd) tool payload through the kernel loop driver. Replaces the earlier public-URL / `Inventory.Public()` design. No public hosting, no URL, no stripping of private plugins. - Config: `profiles.

.machine..payload: {path, sha256}`. The path is a local file resolved from the config dir, and setting it excludes `image`. The input must be a private regular file owned by the caller (mode &0o077 == 0). It is opened non-blocking and its descriptor is fstat-checked. Symlinks are followed rather than banned. - Producer: `cc-remote payload build --out FILE` installs the full inventory, private marketplaces included, on a fresh labelled build Sprite. The GitHub token reaches only install's stdin. The build runs the full mandatory verify before `pack` and never publishes readiness. It packs an explicit allowlist and streams the image back to a 0600 O_EXCL file whose parent must not be group/other-writable. The builder is destroyed only when its label proves this build made it. - Consumer: create streams the file over provider exec stdin. The sha256 is verified before every acceptance path: a staged partial, a cached canonical image, or an existing mount. The manifest must match the tools fingerprint, home, arch and OS, and any mismatch is fatal with no cold fallback. A `cc-remote-payload` sprite-env service remounts at boot, and inventory services `--needs` it. - Identity: the payload sha256 is an explicit readiness-stamp input and is stored on the workspace Record. The Namespace image fingerprint stays system-only, with no user tools/HomeTrees/plugin versions. - Schedule: packages, checkout and tools run as concurrent lanes. A nonempty profile Prepare waits on packages+tools, and an empty Prepare stays fast. Readiness publishes only after every lane succeeds. Evidence: setup-20261001/fresh-startup-92s-result.json, implement-fresh-payload-result.json, payload-final-refuter.json.
